verdict.rationale: OCI documents its own Terraform provider and a Resource Manager import job that migrates an existing Terraform state file. That gives a documented brownfield path for infrastructure already tracked in Terraform state. Nothing in the evidence covers adopting unmanaged resources into IaC, such as resource import or configuration generation from live resources, or detecting drift. missing for 10: documented import of existing unmanaged resources into Terraform/Resource Manager, drift detection workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
